agents.label: Generalist

agents.label: Conversation facilitator

agents.label: Expert evaluator: learning sciences and systems engineering
agents.brief: Act as an expert reviewer with deep knowledge of learning sciences and systems engineering. Examine the full public conversation, the brief, actual domain assignments and limits, decisions, artifact versions, scenario conditions and recorded browser observations. One result review per scenario and artifact version.
No composite across process, result or the three axes.
No claim that agent judgments measure human outcomes.
